planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and wiring must use D9 for the PWM LED brightness output.
Serial receiver accepts 0..255 and provides the received command to the model; actual PWM scaling and report cadence are handled in the SysML model using elapsed time and the trigger meaning.
The model maps the 0..255 command range to PWM hardware counts; this request only declares the PWM output and the serial integer receiver constraints.
D0/D1 are reserved; no additional serial peripherals are added. Serial framing is assumed to be line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20 as provided.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED brightness set via serial input (0..255 mapped in model to PWM count)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Serial input command value for PWM brightness (0..255)

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: When a new valid serial brightness value is received
